description: Nuestro equipo, Equinox  Explorers, creará un entrenador web interactivo para futuros astronautas junior. Incluirá un simulador de supervivencia, donde el usuario enfrenta emergencias espaciales y aprende de sus decisiones, y un mapa interactivo de la misión con datos reales de NASA, para explorar cada fase del viaje de forma divertida y sencilla.s.
summary: Equinox Mission Trainer is an independent, kid-friendly web app for ages 8–12 created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge challenge “Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.” Players learn about a space mission through four ordered phases—Launch, Orbit, Life on board, and Return—with three source-linked facts in each phase. They then play two emergency scenarios: a solar-weather alert and one randomly selected emergency. Each choice uses Energy, Oxygen, or Shield, helping players see the trade-offs behind mission decisions. NASA DONKI supplies a recent space-weather event when online, and NASA OSDR provides a spaceflight research spotlight; saved examples keep these cards available offline. Points, badges, ranks, hints, and a personalized diploma encourage replay. The goal is to spark curiosity and practice resource-aware thinking. This is an educational simulation, not real astronaut procedure or an official NASA product.
details:
Equinox Mission Trainer introduces a space mission through an ordered Mission Map with four phases and three source-linked facts in each phase. Players then enter the Emergency Simulator, where each run includes the Solar Storm scenario and one randomly selected emergency. They choose between actions that use Energy, Oxygen, and Shield, see immediate feedback, and can spend one mission point to reveal a training hint. Results show mission points, a rank, earned badges, and a personalized diploma that can be printed.

The app uses NASA CCMC DONKI for space-weather events and NASA OSDR for a Science Spotlight, with saved examples when the network is unavailable. It also includes NASA and Canadian Space Agency learning resources. It was built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript; React 18 is used for the decorative space scene. It has no backend or build step and is designed to run from index.html or GitHub Pages.

Its goal is to help children explore spaceflight and practice thinking about resource trade-offs. The scenarios are educational simulations, not real astronaut procedures. Equinox Mission Trainer is an independent student project and is not endorsed by NASA.
